answer: Start from optimistic fraud proof for an L2 state root. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 8502 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One sable of signal, one wharf of cost, one yarrow of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
